customSubmitEndpoint.title: Custom Submit Endpoint
customSubmitEndpoint.caption: Send transactions through a custom Cardano node and Cardano Submit API.

setting.caption: Set up a custom Cardano node and Cardano Submit API endpoint for submitting transactions.

note.title: Please Note!
note.caption: This is an advanced setting, and you should only use it if you fully understand what it means.
note.description:
Make sure your custom endpoint is trustworthy and fully synced.

If it's not, the node operator might hold back your transactions for their own gain, or they might not broadcast them at all, and all your transactions could fail.

If you're not sure, just turn this setting off to send transactions through the $t(common:appName) infrastructure.
note.cors: Also, make sure your custom endpoint has the right CORS headers set up to accept the request $t(common:appName) is sending.
